title: Strieber taken to a school for special children in Baja California

tellings.quote: at one point he was taken from the place uh the the the base at Randolph Air Force um to a school for special children in Baja California.

plain: In the 1950s, a boy named Whitley Strieber was taken from Randolph Air Force Base, a US Air Force base, to a school for special children in Baja California, Mexico. The researcher and philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this, passing on what Strieber himself told him. If true, it would mean the military was moving certain children to a special school in secret.
